name: Hooks
overview: Scripture describes hooks primarily as functional and decorative elements in the construction of the tabernacle and temple furnishings, often made of precious metals such as gold and silver to signify their sacred purpose (Exodus 26:32, 26:37, 36:36). These hooks secured the pillars and hangings, reflecting careful craftsmanship and reverence for God's dwelling place (Exodus 27:10, 38:10, 38:17). Beyond their physical use, hooks also appear in figurative contexts and practical applications like fishing and pruning, illustrating their diverse symbolic and everyday significance.
